meaning:
πραγματία (Rec. -εία, as in cl.), -ας, ἡ
(πραγματεύομαι) [in LXX for חֲשַׁל, etc. ;]
1. careful application, hard work.
2. business, occupation: pl., 2Ti.2:4.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
